title: Putty and Texture
intro: Our putty products are premium surface preparation solutions designed to create smooth, even, and defect-free substrates for painting or finishing applications. They effectively fill minor cracks, surface imperfections, and uneven areas, ensuring a durable, uniform, and high-quality base that enhances the longevity, appearance, and performance of subsequent coatings across residential, commercial, and industrial projects.

products.name: Durowhite Plaster
products.description: Durowhite Plaster is a premium-grade, white cement-based wall plaster ideal for interior and exterior applications. It provides a smooth, crack-free, and paint-ready surface with superior bonding and water resistance. Perfect for modern construction, it ensures excellent finish, workability, and long-term durability.

products.name: Dampshield Wall Putty
products.description: Dampshield Wall Putty (20 Kg) is a high-performance, white cement-based putty specially formulated to resist dampness and efflorescence on interior and exterior walls. It provides a smooth, water-resistant, and paint-ready surface with superior adhesion and durability. Ideal for long-lasting wall protection in all weather conditions.

products.name: Cretex Rustique
products.description: Cretex Rustique is a wall putty / texture solution from Ethios that creates smooth, even surfaces as a durable base for paint finishes. Contact our technical team for the data sheet and coverage details.

products.name: Cretex Perlina
products.description: CRETEX PERLINA is a fine-grain decorative wall coating formulated to create a smooth, natural stone-like textured finish. Designed for both interior and exterior applications, it produces a soft, uniform pattern that enhances the appearance of surfaces while maintaining a light, refined visual appeal.

products.name: Sikagard®-694 F(I)
products.description: Sikagard-694 F(I), Component A is a high-performance epoxy-based sealing system used for concrete protection and structural waterproofing. Formulated as a durable paste, it offers excellent adhesion, chemical resistance, and long-lasting barrier properties. Ideal for industrial, infrastructure, and marine applications requiring superior protective coatings.
